story: The Common Kestral (Falco tinnunculus) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Falconidae family. It is most commonly observed in Open grassy fields; farmlands; cities; moorland; heathland; grassland; and savanna, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Common Kestral is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Common Kestral into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
